title: Share one generator contract across agent, CLI, and scripted drivers
narrative: Agent, human CLI/TUI, and scripted tests must use the same tool protocol and graph definitions so fixtures and production drivers cannot drift. Core ops and the stdio MCP adapter ship now; human CLI/TUI remains a milestone. Tracks R-IOC-DRIVERS[^insp-ioc-10].
implementation: `DurableGraphGenerator` public ops, `ScriptedDriver`, and `mechaharness.mcp_graph_driver` (stdio MCP). Human CLI/TUI clients remain gap.
validation: Harness `durable_graph_generator` op `durable_shared_driver_contract`. Hard expects core ops, ScriptedDriver, and MCP adapter present; cli_client_gap true.
